author: CC
prose: The foreign-replace guard (_refuse_a_foreign_replace, ticket 3deafc9e36de) is off in every real case on akiendelllinux. Measured 2026-11-13: _house_root() returns None under /usr/bin/python3 (no cairn distribution), and None under ~/.cairn/venv/bin/python3 too whenever a checkout is on PYTHONPATH, which bin/cairn always sets. That covers the house, worktree cairn-0156, venv and system python. Every checkout carries a gitignored cairn.egg-info with no direct_url.json, and it shadows the venv's cairn-0.0.0.dist-info/direct_url.json (which does name file:///home/akien/dev/src/cairn). When the house root is None the guard returns and the replace proceeds, so a guard that switches off when its input is missing is a hidden green. Orchestrator's shape: missing house root -> refuse, or resolve it some other way, never skip. Resolve it from the instance venv's own dist-info by path, and refuse when nothing resolves.
